description: Comprehensive context retrieval evaluation dataset with 80 documents across 6 scopes and 14 languages, 60+ queries including multi-hop, cross-language, semantic, and ACL tests.

documents.content:
Authentication and Token Management

Our system uses OAuth 2.0 with PKCE for all client-side authentication. Access tokens expire after 15 minutes and are refreshed via the /auth/refresh endpoint using a secure HTTP-only refresh token cookie. Token revocation is handled through a Redis-backed denylist with a 5-minute TTL. For service-to-service auth, we use mTLS with SPIFFE/SPIRE for workload identity. The SSO provider supports SAML 2.0 and OpenID Connect 1.0.

Database Schema for Messaging Service

The messaging service uses PostgreSQL 15 with the following core tables:
- messages (id UUID PK, conversation_id FK, sender_id FK, body TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
- conversations (id UUID PK, type ENUM('direct','group'), title VARCHAR(200), created_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
- conversation_members (conversation_id FK, user_id FK, role ENUM('member','admin'), joined_at TIMESTAMPTZ)
- message_attachments (id UUID PK, message_id FK, file_url TEXT, file_type VARCHAR(50), file_size BIGINT)

Indexes: messages(conversation_id, created_at DESC), conversation_members(user_id). Partitioning by month on messages.created_at.

CI/CD Pipeline Configuration

We use GitHub Actions for CI and ArgoCD for CD. The pipeline stages are:
1. lint (cargo clippy --workspace, 2 min)
2. test (cargo test --workspace, 8 min)
3. build (cargo build --release, 5 min)
4. security-scan (trivy, cargo audit, 3 min)
5. deploy-staging (argocd app sync, 2 min)
6. integration-tests (pytest, 10 min)
7. deploy-production (manual approval, argocd app sync)

Kubernetes clusters: 3 nodes (m5.large) in us-east-1, 2 nodes in ap-southeast-1. Auto-scaling: 3-10 nodes based on CPU > 70%.

API Rate Limiting Policy

Rate limits are enforced at the API gateway (Kong) layer:
- Free tier: 100 req/min, 1000 req/hour
- Pro tier: 1000 req/min, 10000 req/hour
- Enterprise: 10000 req/min, unlimited hourly

Limits are per-API-key and per-IP (whichever is lower). 429 responses include Retry-After header. A token bucket algorithm with burst capacity of 2x the steady-state rate is used. Rate limit headers: X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset.

AI Runtime Architecture

The on-device AI runtime follows a 4-plane architecture:
1. Safety Plane (deterministic, WASM-compatible): NFKC normalization, PII detection, URL screening, policy packs
2. Context Plane (encrypted): SQLCipher FTS5, per-scope XChaCha20-Poly1305, dense embeddings (768-dim)
3. Generation Plane: llama.cpp backend with Metal/Vulkan, JSON Schema grammar constraints, LoRA hot-swap
4. Action Plane: typed artifact AST, ToolPlan validation, RBAC broker, commit tokens

Device tiers: Low (no gen model), Medium (1.7B model), High (4B-8B model). All tiers run the safety plane.

Bảo mật và Mã hóa Infrastructure

Hệ thống sử dụng AES-256-GCM cho mã hóa at-rest và TLS 1.3 cho in-transit. Khóa chính được quản lý qua AWS KMS với rotation 90 ngày. Mỗi scope có khóa riêng (XChaCha20-Poly1305) được derive từ master key bằng HKDF-SHA256. Certificate rotation qua cert-manager 12 tháng. HSM được dùng cho khóa production.

パフォーマンス目標 — モバイル

モバイルデバイスのパフォーマンス目標:
- TTFT (Time To First Token): Low tier < 3000ms, Medium < 1500ms, High < 800ms
- デコード速度: Low N/A, Medium > 15 tok/s, High > 30 tok/s
- メモリ使用量: Low < 512MB, Medium < 1.5GB, High < 3GB
- バッテリー消費: 1時間の使用で < 15%
- 起動時間: < 2秒

測定は iPhone 12 (Low), iPhone 14 (Medium), iPhone 15 Pro (High) で実施。

微服务架构与 gRPC

系统采用 gRPC + Protocol Buffers 进行服务间通信。核心微服务:
- auth-service (端口 50051): 认证、令牌管理
- message-service (端口 50052): 消息收发、会话管理
- media-service (端口 50053): 文件上传、缩略图
- push-service (端口 50054): 推送通知
- search-service (端口 50055): 全文搜索

使用 Envoy 作为服务网格,支持负载均衡、熔断(阈值: 5% 错误率/10秒)、重试(最多3次)。服务发现通过 Consul。

ऐप स्टोर ऑप्टिमाइज़ेशन (ASO) रणनीति

ASO के लिए प्रमुख बिंदु:
- शीर्षक: 30 अक्षर, ब्रांड नाम + प्रमुख कीवर्ड
- उपशीर्षक: 30 अक्षर, द्वितीयक कीवर्ड
- कीवर्ड फील्ड (iOS): 100 अक्षर, कॉमा-सेपरेटेड
- विवरण: 4000 अक्षर, पहले 250 अक्षर सबसे महत्वपूर्ण
- स्क्रीनशॉट: पहले 3 स्क्रीनशॉट 60% रूपांतरण प्रभाव
- A/B परीक्षण: StoreKit प्रोमोशनल बैनर के साथ

लक्ष्य: 10 प्रमुख खोज शब्दों में शीर्ष 5 रैंकिंग।

Observability Stack

We use OpenTelemetry for distributed tracing, Prometheus for metrics, and Loki for log aggregation. The three pillars:
1. Metrics: RED (Rate, Errors, Duration) per service, histograms for latency, gauges for queue depth
2. Traces: 1% sampling in prod, 100% in staging. Span attributes include user_id, scope, model_tier
3. Logs: structured JSON, shipped via Fluent Bit to Loki. Retention: 7 days hot, 30 days warm, 1 year cold (S3)

Dashboards: Grafana with 4 panels — Service Health, Latency P50/P95/P99, Error Budget Burn, Model Performance.

Test Strategy and Coverage

Test pyramid:
- Unit tests: 3000+ tests, run on every PR (cargo test, 8 min)
- Integration tests: 200+ tests, run on merge to main (docker-compose, 15 min)
- E2E tests: 50+ tests, run nightly (Playwright, 45 min)
- Load tests: k6 scripts, run weekly (1000 concurrent users, 10 min)

Coverage targets: 80% line coverage for core crates, 70% for bindings. Coverage measured via cargo-tarpaulin. Flaky test policy: 3 consecutive failures → quarantine → fix within 48h.

Incident Response and On-Call

Severity levels:
- SEV1 (critical): full outage, data loss. Response: 5 min. Page all on-call engineers.
- SEV2 (major): partial outage, degraded service. Response: 15 min. Page primary on-call.
- SEV3 (minor): limited impact, workaround exists. Response: 1 hour. Slack notification.
- SEV4 (low): cosmetic, no user impact. Response: next business day.

Postmortem: required for SEV1/SEV2 within 48h. Blameless format. Action items tracked in Jira with 2-week SLA. Monthly review of all open action items.

Data Migration Plan: MongoDB to PostgreSQL

Migration timeline (8 weeks):
Week 1-2: Schema design, dual-write proxy setup
Week 3-4: Backfill historical data (50M records, 48 hours via Spark)
Week 5-6: Read traffic cutover (10% → 50% → 100%)
Week 7: Write traffic cutover, MongoDB read-only
Week 8: Validation, MongoDB decommission

Rollback plan: dual-write proxy can redirect back to MongoDB within 5 minutes. Data consistency checks: hourly checksums on 1% sample. Zero-downtime requirement: met via dual-read phase.

Vulnerability Management

Scanning: Trivy (container images), cargo-audit (Rust deps), npm audit (frontend), Snyk (all languages). Schedule: daily on main branch, weekly on release branches.

SLA for remediation:
- Critical (CVSS 9+): 24 hours
- High (CVSS 7-8.9): 7 days
- Medium (CVSS 4-6.9): 30 days
- Low (CVSS <4): next release

Disclosure: coordinated via security@kchat.com. Bug bounty: $500-$5000 via HackerOne. CVE assignment for confirmed criticals.

Caching Strategy

Multi-layer caching:
1. CDN (Cloudflare): static assets, 1 year TTL, cache-key includes content hash
2. Edge (Cloudflare Workers): API responses, 60s TTL, stale-while-revalidate
3. Application (Redis cluster): session data (15 min), user profiles (5 min), feature flags (60s)
4. Database (PostgreSQL): materialized views for analytics, refreshed hourly

Cache invalidation: tag-based (Cloudflare), event-driven (Redis pub/sub), scheduled (materialized views). Hit rate targets: CDN > 95%, Redis > 90%.

Internationalization (i18n) Guidelines

Supported languages: en, vi, zh, ja, ko, es, fr, de, ar, hi, th, id, pt, tl (14 total).

Rules:
- Use ICU MessageFormat for all user-facing strings
- Never hardcode strings in source — use .ftl (Fluent) resource files
- RTL support for ar (right-to-left layout)
- Date/time: use Intl.DateTimeFormat, never hardcoded formats
- Numbers/currency: use Intl.NumberFormat
- Pluralization: CLDR rules per language
- Translation pipeline: source en → Crowdin → 14 target languages → PR review → merge
- Quality gate: native speaker review for all user-facing strings

GraphQL Federation Setup

We use Apollo Federation 2 with 5 subgraphs:
- auth-subgraph (User, AuthSession)
- messaging-subgraph (Conversation, Message, Attachment)
- media-subgraph (File, Thumbnail)
- notification-subgraph (Notification, DeviceToken)
- analytics-subgraph (Event, Metric)

Gateway: Apollo Router (Rust). Query complexity limit: 1000. Depth limit: 10. Persisted queries: enabled in production. DataLoader: batched and cached per-request. Schema registry: Apollo Studio, schema checks on every PR.

Deployment Strategies

Blue-Green: used for database migrations. Two identical environments (blue/green). Switch via DNS (5 min TTL). Rollback: DNS switch back.

Canary: used for application code. Traffic splitting: 5% → 25% → 50% → 100%, 1 hour per stage. Auto-rollback if error rate > 2% or P95 latency > baseline + 20%. Metrics: error rate, latency, conversion rate.

Feature flags: LaunchDarkly. 200+ flags in production. Stale flag cleanup: quarterly. Flag naming: team_feature_purpose (e.g., messaging_reactions_v2).

WebSocket Realtime Connection

Realtime updates use WebSocket via a dedicated gateway (ws.kchat.com). Connection lifecycle:
- Connect: wss://ws.kchat.com/v1/connect?token=<JWT>
- Heartbeat: ping/pong every 30s, timeout 60s
- Reconnection: exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, max 30s)
- Message format: JSON with type field (message_new, message_update, typing, presence)

Scaling: sticky sessions via Redis pub/sub fan-out. 50K concurrent connections per gateway node. Auto-scale: 3-20 nodes based on connection count. Geographic: 3 regions (us-east, eu-west, ap-southeast).

Accessibility (a11y) Standards

Target: WCAG 2.2 AA compliance.

Key requirements:
- Color contrast: 4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text
- Keyboard navigation: all interactive elements reachable via Tab, no keyboard traps
- Screen reader: ARIA labels on all icon-only buttons, live regions for dynamic content
- Focus management: visible focus rings, logical tab order, focus trap in modals
- Touch targets: minimum 44x44px on mobile
- Reduced motion: respect prefers-reduced-motion

Testing: axe-core in CI, manual NVDA/VoiceOver testing per release, external audit annually.

Q3 Marketing Campaign Budget

Total Q3 budget: $250,000
Allocation:
- Digital ads (Google, Meta, TikTok): $120,000 (48%)
- Content marketing: $40,000 (16%)
- Influencer partnerships: $50,000 (20%)
- Events & sponsorships: $25,000 (10%)
- Tools & analytics: $15,000 (6%)

Regional split: North America 40%, Southeast Asia 30%, Europe 20%, Other 10%. KPIs: CAC < $25, LTV/CAC > 3, brand awareness +15% in target markets.

Brand Design Guidelines v3

Brand colors:
- Primary: #4F46E5 (Indigo)
- Secondary: #10B981 (Emerald)
- Accent: #F59E0B (Amber)
- Neutral: #1F2937, #6B7280, #E5E7EB, #F9FAFB

Typography: Inter (primary), Noto Sans (CJK fallback). Logo: minimum 24px height, clear space = 1x logo height. Icon style: Lucide icons, 1.5px stroke. Photography: authentic, candid, natural lighting. Illustration: flat, geometric, brand palette only.

Marketing Strategie DACH Region

Q3 Budget DACH: €75,000
- Google Ads: €25,000
- LinkedIn Ads: €15,000
- Content (Blog, Whitepaper): €20,000
- Events (München Meetup, Berlin Tech Day): €15,000

Zielgruppe: B2B SaaS Unternehmen, 50-500 Mitarbeiter. Key Messages: 'On-Device AI für maximale Privatsphäre', 'DSGVO-konform von Grund auf'. KPIs: MQLs +30%, CPL < €50, Pipeline €500K.

Campaña Marketing LATAM Q3

Presupuesto: $45,000 USD
- Meta Ads (Instagram, WhatsApp): $18,000
- Google Ads: $12,000
- Influencers (México, Colombia, Brasil): $10,000
- Contenido (Blog, YouTube): $5,000

Mercados clave: México, Colombia, Argentina, Chile. Mensaje: 'IA privada en tu dispositivo, sin servidores'. KPIs: CAC < $15, instalaciones orgánicas +40%, retención D30 > 35%.

Content Strategy and SEO

Blog cadence: 2 posts/week (Tuesday, Thursday). Topics mapped to customer journey:
- Awareness: 'What is on-device AI?', 'Privacy-first messaging apps'
- Consideration: 'KChat vs WhatsApp: Privacy comparison', 'How AI works offline'
- Decision: 'KChat enterprise deployment guide', 'Security audit results'

SEO targets: 50 keywords in top 10, 10 keywords in top 3. Backlink goal: 20 DR40+ links per quarter. Content length: 1500-2500 words. Internal linking: 3+ per article. Schema markup: Article, FAQ, HowTo.

Social Media and Community Management

Channels:
- Twitter/X: 3 posts/day, tech-focused, 50K followers
- LinkedIn: 1 post/day, B2B focused, 25K followers
- Discord: community server, 10K members, 3 community managers
- Reddit: r/kchat (5K), r/privacy (participation only)

Engagement targets: response time < 4 hours, sentiment score > 0.7. Community programs: monthly dev challenge, quarterly contributor spotlight. Crisis protocol: SEV1 within 1 hour, SEV2 within 4 hours.

Marketing Analytics and Attribution

Attribution model: data-driven (Shapley values), 30-day lookback window.
Funnel stages:
1. Impression → Click (CTR target: 2%)
2. Click → Install (CVR target: 15%)
3. Install → Sign up (CVR target: 60%)
4. Sign up → Active (D7 retention target: 40%)
5. Active → Paid (conversion target: 5%)

Tools: AppsFlyer (mobile attribution), GA4 (web), Mixpanel (product analytics), Amplitude (cohort analysis). Weekly dashboard: CAC by channel, LTV by cohort, payback period.

Campagne Marketing France Q3

Budget: €40,000
- Google Ads: €12,000
- LinkedIn Ads: €10,000
- Content (Blog FR, Whitepaper): €10,000
- Events (Paris Tech Summit, Lyon Meetup): €8,000

Public cible: entreprises tech, 50-300 employés. Message clé: 'IA sur appareil, conformité RGPD native'. KPIs: MQLs +25%, CPL < €60, NPS > 50.

Campanha Marketing Brasil Q3

Orçamento: R$150,000
- Meta Ads (Instagram, WhatsApp): R$60,000
- Google Ads: R$40,000
- Influencers (Brasil): R$30,000
- Conteúdo (Blog, YouTube): R$20,000

Mercado: Brasil, Portugal. Mensagem: 'IA privada no seu dispositivo, sem servidores'. KPIs: CAC < R$80, instalações orgânicas +50%, retenção D30 > 30%.

Email Lifecycle Automation

Journey stages:
1. Welcome series (5 emails, days 0,1,3,7,14): onboarding tips, feature highlights
2. Activation: inactivity trigger at day 3 → re-engagement email
3. Weekly digest: every Monday, personalized content based on usage
4. Win-back: day 30 inactivity → 3-email series with discount
5. Upsell: trigger when user hits free tier limits

Tools: Customer.io for behavioral emails, SendGrid for transactional. Open rate target: 35%, CTR target: 8%. A/B testing: subject lines (50/50 split), send time optimization.

PR and Media Relations

Press kit: kchat.com/press (logos, screenshots, executive bios, fact sheet). Media contacts: 200+ journalists in tech, privacy, enterprise SaaS.

PR cadence:
- Product launches: embargoed press releases 48h before
- Funding rounds: coordinated with TechCrunch, The Verge, Axios
- Thought leadership: 2 op-eds per quarter from CEO/CTO
- Awards: apply to Webby, Fast Company Innovation, Time100

Crisis comms: holding statement within 1 hour, full response within 4 hours. Spokesperson: CEO for SEV1, VP Comms for SEV2-3.

한국 마케팅 캠페인 Q3

예산: ₩50,000,000
- 네이버 광고: ₩20,000,000
- 카카오광고: ₩15,000,000
- 인플루언서: ₩10,000,000
- 콘텐츠(블로그, 유튜브): ₩5,000,000

타겟: 20-40대 IT 직장인. 핵심 메시지: '기기 내 AI, 완벽한 프라이버시'. KPIs: CAC < ₩15,000, 유기적 설치 +35%, D30 유지 > 40%.

日本マーケティングキャンペーン Q3

予算: ¥5,000,000
- Google広告: ¥2,000,000
- X(Twitter)広告: ¥1,500,000
- インフルエンサー: ¥1,000,000
- コンテンツ(ブログ、YouTube): ¥500,000

ターゲット: 20-40代ITエンジニア。主要メッセージ: 'オンデバイスAI、完全なプライバシー'。KPIs: CAC < ¥3,000、オーガニックインストール +30%、D30維持率 > 45%。

แคมเปญการตลาดไทย Q3

งบประมาณ: ฿1,500,000
- Meta Ads (Instagram, Facebook): ฿600,000
- Google Ads: ฿400,000
- อินฟลูเอนเซอร์: ฿300,000
- คอนเทนต์ (บล็อก, YouTube): ฿200,000

กลุ่มเป้าหมาย: วัยทำงาน 20-40 ปี สนใจเทคโนโลยี. ข้อความหลัก: 'AI บนอุปกรณ์ ความเป็นส่วนตัวสูงสุด'. KPIs: CAC < ฿500, ดาวน์โหลดออร์แกนิก +40%, อัตราการรักษา D30 > 35%.

Kampanye Marketing Indonesia Q3

Budget: Rp 500,000,000
- Meta Ads (Instagram, WhatsApp): Rp 200,000,000
- Google Ads: Rp 150,000,000
- Influencer: Rp 100,000,000
- Konten (Blog, YouTube): Rp 50,000,000

Target: profesional muda 20-35 tahun. Pesan utama: 'AI di perangkat, privasi penuh'. KPIs: CAC < Rp 50,000, instalasi organik +45%, retensi D30 > 30%.

GDPR Compliance Framework

Legal basis for processing:
- Consent (Art. 6(1)(a)): explicit opt-in for marketing
- Contract (Art. 6(1)(b)): service provision
- Legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)): security, fraud prevention

Data Subject Rights:
- Access (Art. 15): 30-day response via privacy@kchat.com
- Rectification (Art. 16): in-app profile editing
- Erasure (Art. 17): 'right to be forgotten', 30-day completion
- Portability (Art. 20): JSON export via settings
- Objection (Art. 21): opt-out of profiling

DPO: legal@kchat.com. Lead supervisory authority: CNIL (France). Records of processing: maintained in OneTrust.

Employment Contract Template

Standard terms:
- Probation: 3 months, either party may terminate with 2 weeks notice
- Notice period: 30 days (after probation)
- Non-compete: 12 months post-employment, limited to direct competitors
- IP assignment: all work product assigned to company
- Confidentiality: survives 5 years post-employment
- Remote work: permitted, must maintain core hours (10am-3pm CET)

Benefits: 25 days PTO, health insurance, €2000 learning budget, equipment provided. Equity: per offer letter, 4-year vest with 1-year cliff.

اتفاقية عدم الإفصاح (NDA)

تسري هذه الاتفاقية لمدة 5 سنوات من تاريخ التوقيع.
المعلومات السرية تشمل:
- الكود المصدري والبنية التحتية التقنية
- بيانات العملاء والمستخدمين
- الاستراتيجيات التجارية والمالية
- خطط التسويق والعلاقات

الاستثناءات: المعلومات المتاحة للعامة، المعلومات المعروفة مسبقاً، المعلومات المطلوبة قانونياً. عقوبة الإخلال: تعويض يحدد بحكم المحكمة.

Contrat de Licence Logiciel

Licence: perpétuelle, non-exclusive, non-transférable.
Champ: utilisation interne, nombre d'utilisateurs selon forfait.

Garanties:
- Conformité aux spécifications: 90 jours
- Absence de virus: garantie pour la durée du contrat
- Support: inclus pour la 1ère année, renouvelable

Limitation de responsabilité: plafond = frais de licence des 12 derniers mois. Propriété intellectuelle: concédant conserve tous les droits. Résiliation: manquement non réparé sous 30 jours. Loi applicable: droit français. Tribunal: Paris.

Data Processing Agreement (DPA)

Per GDPR Art. 28:
- Processor: KChat Inc. processes personal data on behalf of Controller
- Processing scope: messaging, AI inference, analytics as defined in MSA
- Sub-processors: AWS, Cloudflare, Twilio (listed at kchat.com/subprocessors)
- Data location: EU (Frankfurt) for EU controllers, US (Virginia) for US
- Breach notification: 72 hours to Controller
- Deletion on termination: within 90 days, certificate of destruction provided
- Audit: Controller may audit once/year with 30 days notice

International transfers: SCC (2021 modules) + TIA. Transfer tools: encryption, pseudonymization.

Terms of Service (ToS) v4

Key provisions:
- Eligibility: 16+ (GDPR Art. 8), 13+ with parental consent (COPPA)
- Acceptable use: no spam, no illegal content, no harassment, no automated scraping
- Account termination: 30-day notice, data export available
- Service availability: 99.9% SLA for enterprise, best-effort for free
- Dispute resolution: binding arbitration (AAA), class action waiver
- Governing law: Delaware, USA (for US users); Ireland (for EU users)
- Changes to ToS: 30-day notice via email and in-app

Liability cap: $100 or 12 months of fees paid, whichever is greater.

Privacy Policy v4

Data collected:
- Account: email, display name, profile photo
- Messages: end-to-end encrypted, not accessible to KChat
- Metadata: timestamps, contact lists (encrypted)
- Device: model, OS version, app version (for compatibility)
- Telemetry: anonymized, opt-out available

Data retention:
- Active accounts: indefinite
- Deleted accounts: 30 days, then permanent deletion
- Backups: 35 days
- Legal holds: per litigation hold notice

Third parties: AWS (hosting), Cloudflare (CDN), Twilio (SMS). Full list at kchat.com/privacy/third-parties.

CCPA/CPRA Compliance

California Consumer Rights:
- Know: categories and specific pieces of personal info collected
- Delete: request deletion of personal info
- Correct: request correction of inaccurate personal info
- Opt-out: sale or sharing of personal info (we don't sell)
- Limit: use of sensitive personal info
- Non-discrimination: equal service regardless of rights exercised

Response timeline: 45 days (extendable by 45 days with notice). Verification: matching email + phone. Authorized agents: with written permission. DSAR portal: privacy.kchat.com/ca.

Chính sách Bảo mật theo Luật Việt Nam

Theo Nghị định 13/2023/NĐ-CP về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân:
- Cơ sở xử lý: sự đồng ý (điều 7), nghĩa vụ hợp đồng (điều 8)
- Quyền của chủ dữ liệu: truy cập, sao chép, sửa đổi, xóa, ngừng xử lý
- Thông báo vi phạm: 72 giờ cho cơ quan quản lý
- Đại diện bảo vệ dữ liệu: legal@kchat.com
- Chuyển dữ liệu ra nước ngoài: đảm bảo mức bảo vệ tương đương

Lưu trữ: tài khoản hoạt động không thời hạn, tài khoản xóa 30 ngày. Khiếu nại: gửi đến legal@kchat.com hoặc Cục An toàn thông tin.

数据保护政策 — 中国

根据《个人信息保护法》(PIPL):
- 处理依据: 同意(第13条), 履行合同(第13条)
- 个人权利: 知情、决定、查阅、复制、更正、删除
- 跨境传输: 需通过安全评估或标准合同
- 数据本地化: 用户数据存储在中国境内服务器
- 个人信息保护负责人: legal@kchat.com

数据保留: 活跃账户无限期, 注销账户30天后永久删除. 投诉: legal@kchat.com 或国家网信办.

個人情報保護方針 — 日本

個人情報保護法 (APPI) に基づく:
- 利用目的: サービス提供、セキュリティ、改善分析
